verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles computes features on customer profiles through declarative YAML that generates warehouse SQL for feature aggregation, and its ML models append predictive attributes to profiles. Separately, Audiences are built on warehouse sources and activated downstream, and the customer 360 can be pushed to business tools. The evidence never shows these computed or predictive traits being used inside audience targeting, and it does not name LTV, churn or purchase-propensity models. Missing for 10: explicit LTV/churn/propensity model documentation, documented use of computed and predictive traits as audience-builder targeting criteria, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: you declare entities and their attributes in version-controlled YAML, and the system generates warehouse-native SQL that handles identity resolution, incremental computation, and feature aggregation automatically.
Rapidly create customer profiles and build features on top with declarative data modeling.
Instantly tap into RudderStack's library of customizable ML models and append predictive attributes to customer profiles.
Build audiences on warehouse sources and activate them downstream
Push your customer 360 to business tools or access it through a real-time API.
